description: Total electricity generation / load for a country over a date range. Returns {unix_seconds, production_types:[{name, data}]}; data arrays are timestamp-aligned to unix_seconds. Power in MW.

country.description: 2-letter lowercase country code, e.g. "de", "fr", or "all" for the EU aggregate.

end.description: Optional end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

start.description: Optional start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago.

name: total_power
title: Total Power
